title: ABBAS UTHO AAG LAGI JALTE HAIN KHAIME
body:
Shole hain bhadakte huwe har simt dhua'n hai
Zainab pa musibat hai qayamat ka sama hai
Kehti hai Muhafiz Mere parde ka kahan hai
Hamghirate Haidar Meri chaadar to bachaale
<<MINI>>
Abbas Utho aag lagi jalte hain khaime
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir ghaizeYadullah zamaane ko dikhao
Faryaad chaheeti ki hai Imdaad ko aao
Gohar na chhine aake Bhateeji ko bachao
Daaman se Sakina ke hain lipte huwe shole
<<MINI>>
Abbas Utho aag lagi jalte hain khaime
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum aao to phir zulm ki taqat na rahegi
Tum aao to Zainab ki rida chin na sakegi
Tum aao to beemar ki masnad na jalegi
Tum aao to beemar pa barseinge na kode
<<MINI>>
Abbas Utho aag lagi jalte hain khaime
<<DIVIDER>>
Barchhi ki ani par hai abhi tak Dile Akbar
Aur Baap ki aaghosh me kumhla gaye Asghar
Shabbir ki gardan pa chala shimr ka khanjar
Ab Aabide Beemar bhi sholo'n me ghira hai
<<MINI>>
Abbas Utho aag lagi jalte hain khaime
<<DIVIDER>>
Jalti hui reti pa pade hain tane Besar
Ye Auno Mohd hain Wo Qasim hai Wo Akbar
Phir ek naye zulm pa tayyar hai lashkar
Paamaaliye Shabbir ke hote hain iraade
<<MINI>>
Abbas Utho aag lagi jalte hain khaime
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Aale Mohammad pa qayamat ki ghadi hai
Kya waarise Tatheer pa uftaad padi hai
Ye Dukhtare Zehra hai jo balwe me khadi hai
Beemar sambhalta nahi'n kode hain baraste
<<MINI>>
Abbas Utho aag lagi jalte hain khaime
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
